Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the annual report for fiscal year 2025, including the Board of Directors' report and the Board of Commissioners' supervisory report, and ratified the consolidated financial statements audited by KAP Anwar & Rekan with a fair opinion, granting full discharge to the Directors and Commissioners. Quorum was 68.051% with 99.975% voting in favor.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved the use of net profit of Rp632,902,896,073, including a cash dividend of Rp2 per share, a reserve fund of Rp1,000,000,000, and the remainder as retained earnings, with authority delegated to the Directors to set the dividend payment schedule. 99.96% voted in favor.
Agenda #3: Shareholders authorized the Board of Commissioners to set Directors' remuneration for 2026 and set Commissioner remuneration at the same level as the previous year, adjustable based on the company's financial condition. 99.959% voted in favor.
Agenda #4: Shareholders delegated authority to the Board of Commissioners to appoint an OJK-registered Public Accounting Firm to audit the 2026 financial statements, with the Directors authorized to determine the honorarium and other requirements. 97.659% voted in favor.
Agenda #5: Shareholders approved the dismissal of Hermansjah Haryono as President Commissioner, the reassignment of Yune Marketatmo from President Director to Director, and the appointment of Hashim Sujono Djojohadikusumo as President Commissioner, Fadel Muhammad as Commissioner, Hendrik Tee as President Director, and Henny Santoso as Director, effective from the close of the meeting. 95.479% voted in favor.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved the amendment of Article 3 of the Articles of Association to align with BPS Regulation No. 7 of 2025 on the Indonesian Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI) 2025. 95.821% voted in favor.
Agenda #7: The shareholders noted the report on the realization of use of proceeds from the 2025 Rights Issue, but no decision was taken as no resolution was required for this agenda.
